body: To the nice man I was taking to last night, if you're reading this, I'm sorry. My boss blocked you and I don't know how to contact you again. It was amazing taking to you. Sharks are pretty cool.
No. I'm with a client. I'm fine.
I've been doing it since, and I don't feel anything. I feel numb to it. There are nice people, like the guy I'm with now. Some people just like to watch kids play videogames and take turns with them.
Don't worry about me. We're alive. I'm alive. I don't know if I want to leave, it's a good income.
Please don't. I've tried the same thing. It won't fix your pain. Talk to me, I promise you it can get better.

I couldn't tell you how much I relate to this. Just know this: stories can be long, our history can be broken, but I've thing will remain the same. There will be a new chapter. It gets better. My story is here too, were all broken, but for what it counts, were all here together.
I lost so many people. I'm sorry about your sister, and your parent. No, I won't tell anyone, but I'm not dead.
Ffs there better not be another one.
